# Load data

```{r}
ps_rare_16S <- readRDS(file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "2_RarefyData", "16S_TM123_ps_rare.rds"))
ps_rare_ITS <- readRDS(file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "2_RarefyData", "ITS_TM123_ps_rare.rds"))

# Make data fit for plot
B = phyloseq::psmelt(ps_rare_16S) 
# Possible to focus on a reduced dataset ex. B = subset_taxa(S_ps_rare_16S, Genus == "Chlamydiae")

B$LifeStage <- factor(B$LifeStage, levels = c("Mother", "Larva", "Pupa", "PupalCase","Daughter", "na"))
B$FruitType <- factor(B$FruitType, levels = c("BL", "CH", "ST", "na"))

write.table(x=B, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "3_CommunityComposition", "16S_melt_TM123.csv"), row.names=FALSE, quote=FALSE, sep=";")


L = phyloseq::psmelt(ps_rare_ITS)

L$LifeStage <- factor(L$LifeStage, levels = c("Mother", "Larva", "Pupa", "PupalCase","Daughter", "na"))
L$FruitType <- factor(L$FruitType, levels = c("BL", "CH", "ST", "na"))

write.table(x=L, file=file.path(here::here(),"data", "derived_data", "3_CommunityComposition", "ITS_melt_TM123.csv"), row.names=FALSE, quote=FALSE, sep=";")
```

# I. Composition (abundance)

## 1. Bar plots

### a. Dataset 1 (indiv + host fruits)
```{r}
ps_rare_16S_Dataset_1 <- readRDS(file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "2_RarefyData", "16S_TM123_ps_rare_Dataset_1.rds"))
ps_rare_ITS_Dataset_1 <- readRDS(file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "2_RarefyData", "ITS_TM123_ps_rare_Dataset_1.rds"))

# Distinguish "Unknown" families & genus by numbering them with their corresponding cluster number
ps_rare_16S_Dataset_1 <- fix_unknown_taxa(phyloseq_object = ps_rare_16S_Dataset_1, ranks = c("Family", "Genus"), outfile = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "3_CommunityComposition", "16S_TM123_tax_table_rare.tsv"))

ps_rare_ITS_Dataset_1 <- fix_unknown_taxa(phyloseq_object = ps_rare_ITS_Dataset_1, ranks = c("Family", "Genus"), outfile = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "3_CommunityComposition", "ITS_TM123_tax_table_rare.tsv"))
```

```{r}
# Filter data (exclude Nat_Uninf_Fruits_5_6days)
ps_16S_rare_expe <- Subset_physeq(ps_rare_16S_Dataset_1, SampleType %in%  c("G0_Adults_0days", "G0_Adults_Fruits_2days", "G1_Larvae_Fruits", "G1_Pupae_Fruits", "G1_Adults_Fruits","G1_PupalCase_Fruits", "Artific_Inf_Fruits_5_6days", "Fruits_0days"))

# rename + reorder Sample Type
sample_data(ps_16S_rare_expe)$SampleType <- factor(sample_data(ps_16S_rare_expe)$SampleType)

sample_data(ps_16S_rare_expe)$SampleType <- sample_data(ps_16S_rare_expe)$SampleType %>%
  forcats::fct_recode(
    Mothers_0days = "G0_Adults_0days",
    Mothers_2days = "G0_Adults_Fruits_2days",
    Larvae = "G1_Larvae_Fruits",
    Fruits_5_6days = "Artific_Inf_Fruits_5_6days",
    Pupae = "G1_Pupae_Fruits",
    PupalCases = "G1_PupalCase_Fruits",
    Daughters = "G1_Adults_Fruits")

desired_order <- c("Fruits_0days", "Mothers_0days", "Mothers_2days", "Larvae", "Fruits_5_6days", "Pupae", "PupalCases", "Daughters")  
sample_data(ps_16S_rare_expe)$SampleType <- factor(sample_data(ps_16S_rare_expe)$SampleType, levels = desired_order)


ps_ITS_rare_expe <- Subset_physeq(ps_rare_ITS_Dataset_1, SampleType %in%  c("G0_Adults_0days", "G0_Adults_Fruits_2days", "G1_Larvae_Fruits", "G1_Pupae_Fruits", "G1_Adults_Fruits","G1_PupalCase_Fruits", "Artific_Inf_Fruits_5_6days", "Fruits_0days"))

# rename + reorder Sample Type
sample_data(ps_ITS_rare_expe)$SampleType <- factor(sample_data(ps_ITS_rare_expe)$SampleType)

sample_data(ps_ITS_rare_expe)$SampleType <- sample_data(ps_ITS_rare_expe)$SampleType %>%
  forcats::fct_recode(
    Mothers_0days = "G0_Adults_0days",
    Mothers_2days = "G0_Adults_Fruits_2days",
    Larvae = "G1_Larvae_Fruits",
    Fruits_5_6days = "Artific_Inf_Fruits_5_6days",
    Pupae = "G1_Pupae_Fruits",
    PupalCases = "G1_PupalCase_Fruits",
    Daughters = "G1_Adults_Fruits")

sample_data(ps_ITS_rare_expe)$SampleType <- factor(sample_data(ps_ITS_rare_expe)$SampleType, levels = desired_order)
```

```{r}
#### Bar plots : SampleType x FruitType x Site 

# 16S (Family)
plot_16S_Expe_SampleTypeFruitTypeSite <- Make_composition_bar_plot_2(ps_16S_rare_expe, "Bacteria", "Family", 15, ~SampleType + FruitType+FruitSite, color_16S)

plot_16S_Expe_SampleTypeFruitTypeSite$data$SampleType <- factor(plot_16S_Expe_SampleTypeFruitTypeSite$data$SampleType, levels = c("Fruits_0days", "Fruits_5_6days", "Mothers_0days", "Mothers_2days", "Larvae", "Pupae", "PupalCases","Daughters")) # reorder 

plot_16S_Expe_SampleTypeFruitTypeSite$data <-
  plot_16S_Expe_SampleTypeFruitTypeSite$data %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Sample) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Abundance = Abundance / sum(Abundance)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

ggsave(filename = "B_Expe_SampleType_FruitType_Site.jpg", plot = plot_16S_Expe_SampleTypeFruitTypeSite, path = file.path(here::here(), "plots", "3_CommunityComposition", "Dataset_1"), width = 29.7, height = 21, units = "cm")


# ITS (Family)
plot_ITS_Expe_SampleTypeFruitTypeSite <- Make_composition_bar_plot_2(ps_ITS_rare_expe, "Fungi", "Family", 15, ~SampleType + FruitType+FruitSite, color_ITS) 
# + annotate("text",x = -Inf, y = Inf,label = "B. Fungi", hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.3,  size = 5, fontface = "bold")

plot_ITS_Expe_SampleTypeFruitTypeSite$data$SampleType <- factor(plot_ITS_Expe_SampleTypeFruitTypeSite$data$SampleType, levels = c("Fruits_0days", "Fruits_5_6days", "Mothers_0days", "Mothers_2days", "Larvae", "Pupae", "PupalCases","Daughters")) # reorder 

plot_ITS_Expe_SampleTypeFruitTypeSite$data <-
  plot_ITS_Expe_SampleTypeFruitTypeSite$data %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Sample) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Abundance = Abundance / sum(Abundance)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

ggsave(filename = "Y_Expe_SampleType_FruitType_Site.jpg", plot = plot_ITS_Expe_SampleTypeFruitTypeSite, path = file.path(here::here(), "plots", "3_CommunityComposition", "Dataset_1"), width = 29.7, height = 21, units = "cm")


# Combined plot
barPlot_combined <- 
  (plot_16S_Expe_SampleTypeFruitTypeSite + labs(tag = "A. Bacteria")) /
  (plot_ITS_Expe_SampleTypeFruitTypeSite + labs(tag = "B. Fungi")) +
  plot_layout(ncol = 1) & theme(legend.position = "right", plot.tag = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"))

title_plot <- "Expe_SampleType_FruitType_Site_combined.png"
 cowplot::save_plot(file =here::here("plots", "3_CommunityComposition", "Dataset_1", title_plot), barPlot_combined, base_height = 26/cm(1),  base_width = 34.7/cm(1), dpi = 1200)
```

## 2. Heatmap
